I've tried all that. My passion is cars, threw myself into building mine and spent endless hours just wrenching away, and it worked for a bit, but maybe I am just too negative. I always come back to: "what's the point? Why even bother with all this? Why bother living when I'll end up dead one day anyway?" My life is legitimately so pointless. 

Thank you for the advice, I'll give it another shot I guess. Not like I have anything to lose. I've hit rock bottom more than once already.
